mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id AS memberId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''), u.username, CONCAT('成员 #',m.user_id)) AS memberName, CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''), u.username) IS NULL THEN 'MEMBER_ID_FALLBACK' ELSE NULL END AS memberNameKind FROM org_member m LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.is_deleted=0 AND m.status=0

SELECT t.memberId AS memberId, t.workType AS workType, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(t.createdInPeriod) AS created, SUM(CASE WHEN t.successInPeriod = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN t.category = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND t.successInPeriod = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inProgress, SUM(CASE WHEN t.category = 'NEW' AND t.successInPeriod = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS notStarted, SUM(CASE WHEN t.category = 'PENDING_DECISION' AND t.successInPeriod = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingDecision, SUM(CASE WHEN t.workType = 'REQ' AND t.successInPeriod = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS requirements FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN w.assignee_type='HUMAN' THEN w.assignee_ref ELSE w.assign_operator_id END AS memberId, w.work_type AS workType, CASE WHEN w.gmt_create >= #{start} AND w.gmt_create < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS createdInPeriod, CASE WHEN success.success_at >= #{start} AND success.success_at < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS successInPeriod, AS category FROM workitem w LEFT JOIN status_node sn ON sn.id=w.status_node_id AND sn.tenant_id=w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN () success ON success.id=w.id WHERE w.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.is_deleted=0 AND COALESCE(UPPER(sn.category), '') <> 'CANCELED' AND ( (w.gmt_create >= #{start} AND w.gmt_create < #{end}) OR (success.success_at >= #{start} AND success.success_at < #{end}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workitem_event e WHERE e.tenant_id=w.tenant_id AND e.workitem_id=w.id AND e.gmt_create >= #{start} AND e.gmt_create < #{end}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch d WHERE d.tenant_id=w.tenant_id AND d.workitem_id=w.id AND d.is_deleted=0
AND d.gmt_create < #{end} AND (d.gmt_modified >= #{start} OR d.status IN ('PENDING','PACKAGING','DISPATCHED','ACKED','RUNNING','PAUSING'))) ) ) t GROUP BY t.memberId, t.workType
